personal.preferred_title: Data Engineer | Python, SQL, PySpark, Data Lakes & Pipeline Optimization

summary: Data Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience across Python, SQL, PySpark/Spark, data lakes, data warehousing, ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, SQL optimization, pipeline tuning, and production analytics systems. Strong background building and improving scalable data workflows, curated reporting datasets, validation checks, performance-oriented schemas, and stakeholder-facing analytics. Best aligned to data engineering roles requiring Python, SQL, PySpark, distributed pipeline processing, data lake/data warehouse delivery, business requirements translation, and cross-functional execution; Azure, Databricks, Data Factory, Power BI, Dataiku, and Azure ML are positioned as adjacent or learning areas rather than overstated production ownership.
